mapper.select:
SELECT cr.chat_room_id FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN workspace_members wm ON cr.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN chat_room_members me ON cr.chat_room_id = me.chat_room_id JOIN chat_room_members target ON cr.chat_room_id = target.chat_room_id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workId} AND cr.chat = 'PERSONAL'
AND me.workspace_member_id = #{myWorkId} AND me.status = 0
AND target.workspace_member_id = #{targetWorkId} AND target.status = 0
AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members crm WHERE crm.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id ) = 2
FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (chat_room_id, workspace_member_id, chat, room_name, created) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{myWorkId}, 'PERSONAL', NULL, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO chat_room_members (chat_room_member_id, chat_room_id, workspace_member_id, status, joined, visible_after_message_id, last_read_message_id) VALUES (seq_chat_room_members.NEXTVAL, #{chatRoomId}, #{workMemberId}, 0, SYSDATE, NVL(#{visibleAfterMessageId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{visibleAfterMessageId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0))
mapper.select:
SELECT cr.chat_room_id "chatRoomId", t_wm.member_id "targetMemberId", md.name "targetName" FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN workspace_members wm ON cr.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id
JOIN chat_room_members crm ON cr.chat_room_id = crm.chat_room_id AND crm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_members my_wm ON crm.workspace_member_id = my_wm.workspace_member_id AND my_wm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_domains wd ON my_wm.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y'
JOIN chat_room_members t_crm ON cr.chat_room_id = t_crm.chat_room_id AND t_crm.workspace_member_id != crm.workspace_member_id AND t_crm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_members t_wm ON t_crm.workspace_member_id = t_wm.workspace_member_id AND t_wm.workspace_id = my_wm.workspace_id AND t_wm.status = 0
JOIN member_details md ON t_wm.member_id = md.member_id
WHERE cr.chat = 'PERSONAL' AND my_wm.member_id = #{loginMemberId} AND wm.workspace_id = my_wm.workspace_id AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members crms WHERE crms.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id ) = 2
ORDER BY cr.created DESC, cr.chat_room_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_rooms cr
JOIN workspace_members wm ON cr.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id
JOIN workspace_domains wd ON wm.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y'
JOIN chat_room_members crm ON cr.chat_room_id = crm.chat_room_id AND crm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_members wms ON crm.workspace_member_id = wms.workspace_member_id AND wms.workspace_id = wm.workspace_id AND wms.status = 0
WHERE cr.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND cr.chat IN ('PERSONAL', 'GROUP') AND wms.member_id = #{loginMemberId}

SELECT m.message_id messageId, m.chat_room_id chatRoomId, wm.member_id senderMemberId, md.name senderName, m.content content, m.message_type messageType, TO_CHAR(m.sent, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') sent, (CASE WHEN wm.member_id = #{loginMemberId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mine
FROM chat_messages m
JOIN chat_room_members snd_crm ON m.chat_room_member_id = snd_crm.chat_room_member_id AND m.chat_room_id = snd_crm.chat_room_id
JOIN workspace_members wm ON snd_crm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id
JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id
JOIN chat_room_members vew_crm ON m.chat_room_id = vew_crm.chat_room_id AND vew_crm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_members vew_wm ON vew_crm.workspace_member_id = vew_wm.workspace_member_id AND vew_wm.member_id = #{loginMemberId} AND vew_wm.status = 0
WHERE m.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND m.deleted IS NULL AND m.message_id > NVL(vew_crm.visible_after_message_id, 0)
ORDER BY m.sent ASC, m.message_id ASC

SELECT crm.chat_room_member_id FROM chat_room_members crm JOIN workspace_members wm ON crm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id WHERE crm.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND wm.member_id = #{loginMemberId} AND crm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (message_id, chat_room_id, chat_room_member_id, content, sent) VALUES (seq_chat_messages.NEXTVAL, #{chatRoomId}, #{chatRoomMemberId}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT wm.member_id FROM chat_room_members crm JOIN workspace_members wm ON crm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id WHERE crm.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND crm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0

SELECT cm.content content, TO_CHAR(cm.sent, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') sent FROM chat_messages cm
JOIN chat_room_members vew_crm ON cm.chat_room_id = vew_crm.chat_room_id AND vew_crm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_members vew_wm ON vew_crm.workspace_member_id = vew_wm.workspace_member_id AND vew_wm.member_id = #{loginMemberId} AND vew_wm.status = 0
WHERE cm.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND cm.deleted IS NULL AND cm.message_id > NVL(vew_crm.visible_after_message_id, 0)
ORDER BY cm.sent DESC, cm.message_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages m
JOIN chat_room_members crm ON m.chat_room_id = crm.chat_room_id
JOIN workspace_members wm ON crm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id
WHERE m.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND wm.member_id = #{loginMemberId} AND crm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND m.deleted IS NULL AND m.message_type = 'GENERAL'
AND m.message_id > GREATEST( NVL(crm.last_read_message_id, 0), NVL(crm.visible_after_message_id, 0) )
AND m.chat_room_member_id != crm.chat_room_member_id
SELECT chat_room_id FROM chat_rooms WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} FOR UPDATE
